messages:
lumen_poc_contact: POC update — streaming client in Node is failing to parse SSE. We see partial JSON and then socket close. Happens intermittently after a few KB.

ryan_sales: Thanks. Hosted or Dedicated? Region?

lumen_poc_contact: Hosted, eu-west-1. No request-id in logs. Client error: 'Unexpected end of JSON input' from JSON.parse.

min_engineer: Could be edge/proxy closing mid-event or client not assembling chunks. Can you share a minimal curl capture?

lumen_poc_contact: quick capture:
```
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK
< Content-Type: text/event-stream
< Transfer-Encoding: chunked
{ [512 bytes]
```
Sometimes body ends like: `data: {"msg":"partial text` and then connection closes.

tara_infra: Proxy shows `upstream_write() returned 0` then `502 while reading upstream` around the times you reported. Looks like upstream worker closed unexpectedly or proxy decided to reset.

leo_support: Immediate mitigations: increase proxy idle timeout and disable proxy_buffering for that route. Also recommend client to buffer until event terminator (`\n\n`) before JSON.parse.

min_engineer: Also add short heartbeats from runtime (every 15s) to keep proxies happy. We'll canary config for that org.

[~4m later]

tara_infra: Canary pushed for lumen org: `proxy_buffering off; proxy_read_timeout 180s; send_timeout 180s;` in eu-west. Please retest.

lumen_poc_contact: Retested: 0/10 failures so far (was ~3/10). We'll run a 2h soak.

leo_support: Follow-ups: (1) infra keep canary 48h and gather 502 counts; (2) eng add X-Request-Id on SSE and optional 15s heartbeat; (3) solutions send polyfill snippet for robust SSE parsing.

edgebot: Ticket SF-5001 created to track heartbeat + request-id work, linked to lumen POC.

lumen_poc_contact: Appreciate the fast help :thumbsup:. We'll update after soak.
